rationale: Classifies a complete surplus product CI proof with a valid companion-only candidate plan as stale so the existing exact-material canonical validation runs. It grants no acceptance, schema, permission or budget changes and changes no product behavior.

summary.ru: Непригодный лишний product proof запрашивает каноническую проверку вместо технического возврата автора.
summary.en: An inapplicable surplus product proof requests canonical validation instead of returning the author.
